data.turoyo: Ġalabe aṯile kef lu babo w u babo koməfrəḥ bu kurrəko ġalabe.
data.translation: Er wurde sehr vergnügt und freute sich an seinem Sohne.

rationale: Thin Detransitive Infectum/1 cell; explicit father experiencer and b-marked stimulus.

data.turoyo: Aṯi. I=naqla d aṯi, i=ḥoṯo azzá l foṯe w nšəqla w friḥi b ḥḏoḏe.
data.translation: Als er nach Hause kam, trat ihm die Schwester entgegen und küßte ihn, und sie freuten sich aneinander.

rationale: Thin Detransitive Preterit/1 cell; plural experiencers with reciprocal b-marked stimulus.

summary: The joy occurrences match the glossary’s existing Detransitive forms frīḥ/məfrəḥ. No active transitive joy sense follows from the unrelated-looking feather passage.
I.1 has b-marked stimuli in both eventive reunion and continuing enjoyment of a child; these do not require separate senses or a direct nominal stimulus.
112/290: collate Frəḥle against the edition. Is it Ftəḥle, another root, or an otherwise unattested feather-parting verb? No spelling correction or new active box is published without that check.
Correct the case in an die frische Luft zu kommen
before: an der frische Luft zu kommen
after: an die frische Luft zu kommen
rationale: Kommen expresses motion here and requires an die frische Luft. The current an der frische is also internally ungrammatical: der would require frischen. Correct the case without changing the parenthetical explanation.

summary: The stimulus of rejoicing is marked by b-, either a child or reciprocal ḥḏoḏe; the experiencer is an overt subject.
